title.zh: 新冠病毒颗粒，从中间剖开
title.en: A SARS-CoV-2 virion, cut through the middle

hint.zh: 拖动旋转，用“剖开”滑杆看内部。结构是现取的，需要联网；取过一次后会缓存在本机
hint.en: Drag to rotate; use the cut slider to look inside. The structure is fetched on demand and needs a network connection; after the first time it is cached locally

title.zh: 一整个流感病毒颗粒：膜和上面的几百根“刺”
title.en: A whole influenza virion: the membrane and its hundreds of spikes

hint.zh: 拖动旋转，用“剖开”滑杆看里面；粉紫色是血凝素，橙色是神经氨酸酶。一次全原子模拟的最后一帧，633 万个原子。没有找到这份数据的许可声明，使用时现取。第一次打开时本机要下载 640 MB 并处理，需要联网，可能要半小时；之后直接用存下来的结果
hint.en: Drag to rotate; use the cut slider to look inside. Pink and purple are hemagglutinin, orange is neuraminidase. The last frame of an all-atom simulation, 6.33 million atoms. No licence statement was found for this data, which is fetched when used. The first time, 640 MB is downloaded and processed on this machine, which needs a network connection and may take half an hour; afterwards the stored result is used

hint.zh: 几十亿个原子的模型，粗化成三千万个球来画；拖动旋转，用“剖开”滑杆看内部。第一次打开时本机要下载并处理原文件，需要联网，约两三分钟；之后直接用存下来的结果
hint.en: A model of billions of atoms, coarsened to thirty million spheres for drawing; drag to rotate, and use the cut slider to look inside. The first time, the original is downloaded and processed on this machine, which needs a network connection and takes two or three minutes; afterwards the stored result is used

hint.zh: 滚轮放大看核糖体和 DNA（53 MB，第一次要等一会儿）。结构是现取的，需要联网；取过一次后会缓存在本机
hint.en: Scroll to zoom in on ribosomes and DNA (53 MB; the first load takes a while). The structure is fetched on demand and needs a network connection; after the first time it is cached locally

title.zh: 最小细胞 syn3A 的膜：一个 200 纳米的球和上面的近千个蛋白
title.en: The membrane of the minimal cell syn3A: a 200-nanometre sphere and nearly a thousand proteins on it

hint.zh: 拖动旋转，用“剖开”滑杆看里面。只有膜和膜蛋白，细胞里面的东西不在数据里。第一次打开时本机要从 Zenodo 取 170 MB 并处理，需要联网，约五分钟；之后直接用存下来的结果
hint.en: Drag to rotate; use the cut slider to look inside. Membrane and membrane proteins only: what is inside the cell is not in the data. The first time, 170 MB is fetched from Zenodo and processed on this machine, which needs a network connection and takes about five minutes; afterwards the stored result is used

title.zh: 细胞里核糖体的真实分布和朝向（冷冻电镜断层扫描）
title.en: Where the ribosomes are in a cell, and which way they face (cryo-electron tomography)

hint.zh: 331 个核糖体的位置和朝向都是实测的。拖动旋转，滚轮放大。结构是现取的，需要联网；取过一次后会缓存在本机
hint.en: The positions and orientations of 331 ribosomes are both measured. Drag to rotate, scroll to zoom. The structure is fetched on demand and needs a network connection; after the first time it is cached locally

title.zh: 小脑的浦肯野细胞：一个神经元的树突
title.en: A Purkinje cell of the cerebellum: one neuron's dendrites

hint.zh: 拖动旋转，看它其实是扁的。这是显微重建，单位是微米，不是原子。需要联网，取过一次后会缓存在本机
hint.en: Drag to rotate and see that it is flat. This is a microscopy reconstruction in microns, not atoms. It needs a network connection and is cached locally after the first time

title.zh: 海马的锥体细胞
title.en: A pyramidal cell of the hippocampus

hint.zh: 粉色是胞体，绿色是顶树突，蓝色是基树突。这是显微重建，单位是微米。需要联网，取过一次后会缓存在本机
hint.en: Pink is the soma, green the apical dendrite, blue the basal dendrites. A microscopy reconstruction in microns. It needs a network connection and is cached locally after the first time

title.zh: 皮层里五个相邻的神经元
title.en: Five neighbouring neurons of the cortex

hint.zh: 五个细胞按它们在小鼠视皮层里的真实位置叠在一起，每个一种颜色；拖动旋转。电镜连接组 MICrONS 的骨架，单位是微米；没有找到这份数据的许可声明，使用时现取。需要联网
hint.en: Five cells overlaid where they really lie in the mouse visual cortex, one colour each; drag to rotate. Skeletons from the MICrONS electron-microscopy connectome, in microns; no licence statement was found for this data, which is fetched when used. It needs a network connection

title.zh: 一个 HeLa 细胞里的细胞器（电镜）
title.en: The organelles of a HeLa cell (electron microscopy)

hint.zh: 从上往下看，在半高处剖开：细胞核、内质网（绿）、线粒体（粉）。第一次要下载几百个小文件，约一分钟
hint.en: Seen from above and cut at mid-height: the nucleus, endoplasmic reticulum (green), mitochondria (pink). The first load fetches a few hundred small files and takes about a minute

title.zh: 一张电镜密度图：伴侣蛋白 GroEL
title.en: An electron-microscopy density map: the chaperonin GroEL

hint.zh: 这是实验直接得到的三维密度，不是原子模型。拖动旋转，用“剖开”滑杆看里面的空腔
hint.en: This is the three-dimensional density the experiment gives, not an atomic model. Drag to rotate; use the cut slider to see the cavity inside
